description: 한국전력공사_전력고객주요정보_대용량고객일반정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사에서 제공하는 전력고객주요정보의 대용량고객일반정보 데이터로 대규모 전력 수요 고객의 기본 속성과 관리 기준을 종합적으로 정리한 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전력공사. Its tags are 대용량고객, 일반사항, 변전소, 배전설비, 지역본부. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
